Lower mounting hole lies 35.2 mm below the upper holes and centrally at 18 mm from either upper hole. The lower tab extends 6.4 mm below the main case, giving a 45.2 mm overall bare envelope. Upper hole centres are assumed halfway through the dimensioned 8 mm ears; lower tab rounding is derived from that assumption. Lower case relief, corner fillets and optional horn are simplified. Spline is 25T, Ø4.94 major / Ø4.25 root, with straight-flank approximation; no certified mating fit. No internal motor, gears or wiring.

The spline projects 4 mm above an undimensioned collar: bare total height is illustrative and omitted from numeric search. Older official CAD differs from v2.2 and is not used. Smooth Ø6 shaft is not a mating 25T spline. Default travel is ±60°; ±87.5° requires programming.

name: TowerPro MG996R
description: Manufacturer lists 40.7 × 19.7 × 42.9 mm nominal dimensions, while its configure table lists 40.9 × 20 mm, 37 mm case, 42.7 mm overall and 54 mm ear span. The fixed installation reference retains the Rocket Release nominal 40.7 × 19.7 × 37 mm body with 5.9 mm output projection. Shaft axis, Ø6 smooth output, Ø3.4 bores on 48 × 10 mm pitch, ear elevation/thickness and optional horn are unverified fit references. No mounting pitch or spline tooth count is published as a verified catalog attribute. Source travel is 0–159°; geometric pose is centered ±79.5°. Internal gears, motor, supplied arms, screws and 320 mm wire are excluded. Measure the actual servo and resolve the conflicting source dimensions before machining.

name: TowerPro MG90S
description: Manufacturer lists nominal 22.8 × 12.2 × 28.5 mm dimensions, but its configure table lists C=28.4, D=12.4 and A=32.5 mm. The fixed installation reference retains the Rocket Release nominal 22.8 × 12.2 × 28.5 mm body. The 30.8 mm ears, two Ø2.1 bores at 26.8 mm pitch, shaft axis, Ø4.8 smooth output, 3 mm output projection, ear elevation/thickness and optional horn are unverified fit references. Bare total height and mounting pitch are omitted from catalog attributes. ±90° is an illustrative inspection range, not a sourced travel rating. Source lists 4.8 V operating voltage and separate performance points at higher voltages; a maximum operating voltage is not inferred. Internal gears, motor, supplied arms, screws and 250 mm wire are excluded. Measure the actual servo before machining.
